blocks.text: 05-SET / store setup Goes here. Step-by-step instructions for creating a new Shopify account, claiming trial offers, selecting a subscription plan, and configuring the back-end settings of the store. This includes managing products (titles, descriptions, pricing, inventory tracking, shipping weights/volumes, variants for size/color), organizing manual collections, configuring shipping zones and flat rates, and generating templated legal policies. Not here. • Installing a headless CLI environment to connect AI tools to the theme code -> 05-SET (advanced) • Designing the landing page, selecting themes, or using the storefront editor -> 07-LPG

Header. url: rights: public_reference why: Provides the foundational, step-by-step process for configuring a standard Shopify backend, from initial account creation and billing to product management, manual collections, and flat-rate shipping configurations. modules: [SET] topics: [Shopify setup, product management, shipping configuration, legal policies, custom domains] tier: 2 scope_hint: baseline

Topics. store configuration / claiming trial links, entering payment details, selecting the Basic plan, activating Shopify Payments, verifying identity documents, purchasing a custom domain; product management / adding titles/descriptions, setting prices and "compare at" strikethrough prices, enabling inventory tracking, defining shipping weights/volumes, adding size/color variants; collections / creating manual collections, assigning collection images, routing products into collections; shipping / removing default zones, defining new shipping zones (e.g., US only), establishing flat rates (e.g., Standard $6, Express $15); legal policies / utilizing Shopify templates for Refund, Privacy, and Terms of Service, generating a custom Shipping Policy.
Look for.
The "Compare At" Pricing Rule: Using the "compare at" field to display a strikethrough price, creating a visual discount effect on the product page.
Inventory Tracking: Activating the "continue selling when out of stock" toggle if drop-shipping, or leaving it unchecked to trigger a "sold out" badge when manual inventory hits zero.
Shipping Zone Deletion: The necessary step of deleting Shopify's default shipping zones before adding a new custom zone and configuring flat rates.
Skip. The promotional link for the Shopify $1 trial, the use of ChatGPT to write the shipping policy, or the superficial overview of the taxes dashboard.
Scope mix. 100% baseline (standard Shopify backend configuration). Volume. ~300 words.

07-LPG / landing pages Goes here. Selecting a Shopify theme, navigating the storefront editor, customizing sections (Hero, Featured Collection, Collection List), adjusting typography and color schemes, editing the header/footer, and previewing mobile responsiveness. Not here. • Adding the actual products, prices, and collections in the backend -> 05-SET • The advanced integration of Claude Code or the Shopify CLI -> 05-SET

Header. url: rights: public_reference why: Details the exact process for manipulating the visual front-end of a Shopify store using the native theme editor, covering everything from Hero section layout adjustments to navigation menu nesting. modules: [LPG] topics: [theme selection, storefront editor, section customization, navigation menus, footer cleanup] tier: 2 scope_hint: baseline

Topics. theme selection / browsing the theme store, previewing demos, reverting to the default Horizon theme for maximum feature compatibility (like AI block generation); section customization / adjusting Hero backgrounds, aligning text/buttons to the center, adding Collection Lists (grid layout), adding Featured Collections (carousel layout); global styling / uploading logos and square favicons, adjusting header logo placement, modifying color schemes, adding hover animations (e.g., image zoom); navigation / deleting default menu items, nesting sub-menus (e.g., placing "Shirts" under "Men"); footer cleanup / removing the "Powered by Shopify" text, linking social media icons, and ensuring policy pages appear.
Look for.
The Favicon Requirement: Uploading a square version of the logo to the favicon field so it appears in the browser tab.
Header Logo Alignment: Moving the logo from the default left position to the center of the header to balance the visual layout.
Sub-Menu Nesting: Dragging a collection (e.g., "Shirts") slightly to the right under a main category (e.g., "Men") in the navigation menu settings to create a drop-down menu on the storefront.
Footer Cleanup: Selecting the footer text block and explicitly toggling off "Show Powered by Shopify" to increase professional perception.
Skip. The AI section generator demonstration, as it distracts from the core structural layout principles.
Scope mix. 100% baseline (visual storefront editing). Volume. ~300 words.
